description: Extend the WebUI (weiui/) with a model selector (flux-2-klein-4b / flux-2-klein-9b / flux-2-dev) and width+height resolution controls, while keeping the existing prompt input and steps slider. The steps control's max bound and default value adjust dynamically based on the selected model (klein variants: 1-8, default 4; dev: 1-50, default 25). All new UI strings are added to every locale file under weiui/src/locales/<lang>/translation.json (en, zh_CN, zh_TW, ru, ar, fr, de, es). The api.js client sends the new model/width/height fields to the Worker.
steps: Edit weiui/src/utils/api.js so generateImage accepts an options object: `generateImage(prompt, { model, steps, width, height })`. Send all four fields in the POST body (model and steps default if undefined). Keep the bearer token logic unchanged. Remove the legacy `token` field from the body — it was never read by the Worker. Update the JSDoc accordingly.

Edit weiui/src/components/ImageGenerator.jsx: (a) define a MODELS constant array [{ id: '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b', labelKey: 'imageGenerator.models.klein4b', stepsMin: 1, stepsMax: 8, stepsDefault: 4 }, { id: '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-9b', labelKey: 'imageGenerator.models.klein9b', stepsMin: 1, stepsMax: 8, stepsDefault: 4 }, { id: '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-dev', labelKey: 'imageGenerator.models.dev', stepsMin: 1, stepsMax: 50, stepsDefault: 25 }]; (b) define a SIZE_PRESETS constant [512, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536]; (c) add useState for `model` (default klein-4b), `width` (default 1024), `height` (default 1024); (d) when `model` changes, snap `steps` into the new model's [min,max] range and reset to its default if previously out-of-range; (e) render: a <select> for the model below the prompt textarea, two <select>s for width and height (preset values, custom number input optional but not required), and the existing steps Input — but pass min/max from the active model config and update the label/hint to reference the active range; (f) pass model/width/height alongside prompt and steps to apiService.generateImage; (g) include model name + width x height in the history record and display it next to the prompt in the history list.

Add new i18n keys under `imageGenerator` in every locale file (en, zh_CN, zh_TW, ru, ar, fr, de, es): `modelLabel`, `widthLabel`, `heightLabel`, and a `models` sub-object with `klein4b`, `klein9b`, `dev` containing user-friendly model names (e.g., en: 'FLUX.2 Klein 4B (fast)', 'FLUX.2 Klein 9B (balanced)', 'FLUX.2 Dev (high quality)' — pick natural-sounding equivalents per language). Also update the existing `stepsLabel` from a hardcoded '(1-8)' to use a stepsLabelTemplate that interpolates the active range, e.g. en: 'Steps ({{min}}-{{max}})'. The component should call `t('imageGenerator.stepsLabel', { min, max })`. Update `stepsHint` text only if the existing wording references '1-8' explicitly.

Verify the JSON is still valid in all 8 locale files (no trailing commas) and that every new key is present in every file (a missing key in one locale will not throw but will display the key name to that user).
Run `npm run build` in weiui/ and confirm the Next.js build succeeds. Iterate until clean. There is no test suite for the WebUI.
acceptance_criteria: ImageGenerator.jsx renders three new controls (model selector, width selector, height selector) above the existing steps slider.
Switching the model from klein-4b to flux-2-dev raises the steps input's max attribute to 50 and updates the value to 25 if it was previously below the new default; switching back caps it at 8.
POST body sent by api.js includes prompt, model, width, height, steps. The legacy `token` body field is removed.

All 8 translation.json files contain the new keys: imageGenerator.modelLabel, imageGenerator.widthLabel, imageGenerator.heightLabel, imageGenerator.models.{klein4b,klein9b,dev}, and the parameterized imageGenerator.stepsLabel.
verification: for d in en zh_CN zh_TW ru ar fr de es; do node -e "const j=require('./weiui/src/locales/$d/translation.json'); if(!j.imageGenerator.modelLabel||!j.imageGenerator.widthLabel||!j.imageGenerator.heightLabel||!j.imageGenerator.models||!j.imageGenerator.models.klein4b||!j.imageGenerator.models.klein9b||!j.imageGenerator.models.dev){process.exit(1)}" || echo "MISSING in $d"; done — produces no MISSING output
findings:
Implemented WebUI multi-model selector + width/height controls + dynamic steps in weiui/. Changes:

1) weiui/src/utils/api.js: generateImage signature changed to generateImage(prompt, options = {}) destructuring {model, steps, width, height}. Body is built field-by-field, only including each parameter when defined, so the Worker's defaults remain authoritative. The legacy `token` field is removed from the POST body (Authorization bearer header is unchanged). JSDoc updated with @param descriptions for each option.

2) weiui/src/components/ImageGenerator.jsx: added MODELS constant (klein4b/klein9b stepsMin=1 stepsMax=8 stepsDefault=4; flux-2-dev stepsMin=1 stepsMax=50 stepsDefault=25), DEFAULT_MODEL_ID = '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b', SIZE_PRESETS = [512, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536], DEFAULT_SIZE = 1024. New useState hooks for model, width, height (all defaulting to klein-4b/1024/1024). useMemo derives the active model config; useEffect snaps `steps` into [stepsMin, stepsMax] and resets to stepsDefault when out of range whenever the active model changes. Form layout: prompt textarea, then a model <select>, then a 2-column grid of width/height <select>s, then the existing steps <Input>. Steps Input now uses dynamic min/max from activeModel and the parameterized label t('imageGenerator.stepsLabel', {min, max}). The clamp on manual steps edits also uses the active range. apiService.generateImage receives {model, steps, width, height}. History records include model, modelLabel (translated label resolved at save time), width, height, and the history list renders a small `${modelLabel} · ${width}x${height}` line above the prompt.

3) Added new i18n keys imageGenerator.modelLabel, imageGenerator.widthLabel, imageGenerator.heightLabel, imageGenerator.models.{klein4b,klein9b,dev}, and changed imageGenerator.stepsLabel from a hardcoded '(1-8)' string to a parameterized template using {{min}} and {{max}} interpolations across all 8 locales (en, zh_CN, zh_TW, ru, ar, fr, de, es). Model labels follow the en pattern of '<name> (descriptor)' with descriptors translated per language: en fast/balanced/high quality; es rápido/equilibrado/alta calidad; ar سريع/متوازن/جودة عالية; fr rapide/équilibré/haute qualité; ru быстрый/сбалансированный/высокое качество; zh_CN 快速/均衡/高质量 (with full-width parens); zh_TW 快速/均衡/高品質 (full-width parens); de schnell/ausgewogen/hohe Qualität. Existing stepsHint was NOT touched: none of the 8 locales' stepsHint strings explicitly reference '1-8'.

Verification (PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH): the spec's locale-key check `for d in en zh_CN zh_TW ru ar fr de es; do node -e ... || echo 'MISSING in $d'; done` produced no MISSING output. Additional check confirmed every stepsLabel includes both '{{min}}' and '{{max}}' placeholders. `npm run build` in weiui/ exited 0; Next.js 14.2.25 compiled successfully and statically generated 3 routes (/, /_app, /404). Browserslist printed an outdated-data warning (caniuse-lite is 15 months old) but did not fail the build (same warning was observed in FEAT-001's baseline). No deviations from the spec.
